use: Held-out check of policyengine-uk employment_allowance on the generated firms. Never a calibration target.
method: Read from the downloaded ODS on the access date. claimants: Table 5 (Claimants estimates), row 'Employment Allowance' (NIC - NS6), column '2024 to 2025' (1,223,000). cost_gbp: Table 2 (Six-year cost estimates, GBP million), same row and column (3,300), multiplied by 1,000,000. Table 2 marks 2025 to 2026 as the first forecasted costing year, so 2024-25 is an outturn estimate. HMRC describes the method as 'Administrative data on the use of the relief, with minimal further assumptions applied'. In 2024-25 the allowance was up to GBP 5,000 and employers with GBP 100,000 or more of prior-year secondary Class 1 liabilities could not claim.
